info.title: NAE_Action
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

arguments.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Parameter](#/NAE_Parameter)
References to the Monitoring Parameters used on a specific NAE Action. The map key contains a position in the action and the map value contains the parameter name of the argument in the position.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Action](#/NAE_Action)
Actions that need to be executed when condition is satisfied.

parameter.description: Parameters to be used while executing an Action. For syslog, parameter is the message to be send to the syslog server. For SHOW, parameter is the CLI command to be executed. For CALLBACK, it will contain the script method name that will  be executed. For SHELL, parameter is the command to be executed. For ALERT_LEVEL, parameter is the alert level that the policy agent should be  changed to. Allowed values are "critical", "major", "minor" and "none". For SNMP, parameter is the trap message to be send to the snmp server For SCHEDULE, parameter is the config schedule CLI command to be executed

facility.description: This field is used only if the action is syslog. Send syslog messages based on the facility specified. A facility code is used to specify the type of program  that is logging the message.  `kern`:       Kernal messages. `user`:       User-level messages. `mail`:       Mail system. `daemon`:     System daemons. `auth`:       Security/authorization messages. `syslog`:     Mmessages generated internally by syslogd. `lpr`:        Line printer subsystem. `news`:       Network news subsystem. `uucp`:       UUCP subsystem. `authpriv`:   Security/authorization messages. `cron`:       Scheduling daemon. `ftp`:        FTP daemon. `local0`:     local use 0 (local0). `local1`:     local use 1 (local1). `local2`:     local use 2 (local2). `local3`:     local use 3 (local3). `local4`:     local use 4 (local4). `local5`:     local use 5 (local5]. `local5`:     local use 6 (local6]. `local5`:     local use 7 (local7].

severity.description: This field is used only if the action is syslog. Send syslog messages based on the severity specified. `debug`:   Debug-level messages.            Messages that contain information normally of use             only when debugging a program.  `info`:    Informational messages. `notice`:  Normal but significant conditions.            Conditions that are not error conditions, but that may             require special handling.  `warning`: Warning conditions. `err`:     Error conditions. `crit`:    Critical conditions, such as hard device errors. `alert`:   Action must be taken immediately.            A condition that should be corrected immediately,             such as a corrupted system database.  `emer`:    System is unusable. A panic condition.

title.description: Custom title to be used for a specific predefined NAE Action.

title_arguments.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Parameter](#/NAE_Parameter)
References to the Monitoring Parameters used as arguments in the custom title for a specific predefined NAE Action. The map key contains a position on the custon title and the map value contains the parameter name of the argument in the position.

type.description: Type of the nae action: * `SYSLOG`: Send a local or remote message to a syslog server * `CLI`: Executes a CLI command and stores the output so    it can be accessed through an external application interface. * `CALLBACK`: Executes a python callback method specified on the    associated nae script. CALLBACK is only relevant    for script based policy actions. * `SHELL`: Executes a shell command and stores the output     that can be accessed through an external application interface. * `ALERT_LEVEL`: Change or remove the alert level of policy agent.    Only relevant for policy actions created by the scripts. * `SNMP`: Send a snmp trap message to a snmp server * `SCHEDULE`: Executes a schedule config CLI command`

parameters.name: NAE_Script.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Script](#/NAE_Script)
Name of a NAE Script. This has to be a valid canonical name (CNAME) (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor).

parameters.name: NAE_Agent.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Agent](#/NAE_Agent)
Name of a NAE Agent. This has to be a CNAME starting with NAE Script name followed by its own name (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor.agent1).

parameters.name: NAE_Rule.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Rule](#/NAE_Rule)
Rules created by the particular NAE Agent.

parameters.name: NAE_Condition.condition_type
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Condition](#/NAE_Condition)
Conditions associated with the rule CONDITION : Condition associated with the rule CLEAR_CONDITION : Optional clear condition associated with the rule

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
